title: fix(spec)!: the Field.select string shorthand keeps what it does not document transforming, so a hyphenated option is refused instead of declared as another value
body:
Fixes #25013

Clause-②: no (narrowing: a `Field.select` shorthand string the helper used to rewrite silently, e.g. `'no-overlay'` → `nooverlay`, is refused instead)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed

## What changed

- **`packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` `selectWithOptions`**: the string shorthand's transform is now only what its JSDoc documents: lower-case, and whitespace runs become `_`. It no longer deletes every other character outside `a-z0-9_`. A shorthand string that is no system identifier (`'no-overlay'`) therefore reaches `SelectOptionSchema.value` unchanged and is refused by the rule an explicit `{ value: 'no-overlay' }` already met. No new error code, no parallel validator, and `SelectOptionSchema.value` / `SystemIdentifierSchema` accept and refuse exactly what they did before. The explicit-object branch keeps its lower-casing (documented, and not a strip). The `Field.select` JSDoc states the rule and the explicit spelling to use.
- **`packages/metadata-core` `sys_metadata_audit.lock_state`**: the one in-tree shorthand the strip altered. It declared `none`, `nooverlay`, `nodelete`, `full`, while its writer (`metadata-protocol` `protocol.ts`, `lock_state: entry.lockState ?? 'none'`) stores the `MetadataLock` spelling (`no-overlay`, `no-delete`). A select option value cannot hold a hyphen, so the column is now `Field.text({ maxLength: 255 })`, read-only as before, like the sibling `code` column whose closed set also lives with its writer. Writer and reader unchanged, no stored row rewritten.
- **Translations** (`platform-objects`, regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`): the four `lock_state` option labels drop out; the field label stays.
- **ADR-0087**: a semantic entry `field-select-shorthand-keeps-written-value` (major 18), so the upgrade guide and `os migrate meta` carry the TODO for a TypeScript author whose shorthand now refuses. The changeset's disposition is `registered`.
- **Engine-double ledger**: `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` records the new save-door test's fake engine (`check-engine-double-contract.mjs --write`).

## Premises verified before writing code (ruling part ②)

- **(a) `lock_state` is the only shorthand the strip alters.** A TypeScript-AST census of every `Field.select(...)` call in all 9,792 tracked `.ts/.tsx/.mts/.js/.mjs` files at `ae58b26f9` (140 calls, 189 shorthand strings), comparing the old strip with the documented transform and with the identifier rule: 2 hits, both `sys-metadata-audit.object.ts:190` (`no-overlay`, `no-delete`). The non-literal option lists it could not read statically (`BUILTIN_MEMBERSHIP_ROLE_OPTIONS`, `InvitationStatus.options`, `SYS_ACTIVITY_BUILTIN_TYPES`, and the `.map(...)` builders that write explicit values) were read by hand: all identifiers. A regex census of the 1,016 tracked `.md/.mdx` files (published skills, docs, templates; changelogs excluded): 51 shorthand strings, 0 hits. **Positive control**: the same AST census at `ba244f1^` (before PR #25099) reports the third hit, `sys-oauth-application.object.ts:449` `'user-agent-based'`.
- **(b) `lock_state` can hold what its writer writes without widening the option-value accept set and without rewriting rows.** `Field.text` holds the hyphenated spelling; no option value is involved. Schema drift was measured with `diffManagedTable` on a `varchar(255)` column (the width the select column was created as) on postgres, mysql and sqlite: `select` 0 entries; `text` with no `maxLength` 1 entry on postgres and mysql (`manual_widen_varchar_to_text`, `needs_confirm`); `text` with `maxLength: 32` a destructive `narrow_varchar`; `text` with `maxLength: 255` 0 entries on all three. Hence `maxLength: 255`.

## Where the refusal fires (H3, measured)

- **TypeScript authoring, module load**: `ObjectSchema.create` (the shape every platform object and `os init` template uses) throws a `ZodError` with one issue, `invalid_format` at `fields.FIELD.options.N.value`, message `System identifier must be lowercase, starting with a letter, …`. Before the `lock_state` fix, importing `sys-metadata-audit.object.ts` would have thrown exactly this.
- **The object save door**: `saveMetaItem` answers `422 INVALID_METADATA` with the issue at `fields.status.options.1.value`, code `invalid_format`, and stores nothing; the shorthand and the explicit spelling produce identical `issues`.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/data/field.test.ts`: the hyphen is kept; shorthand and explicit meet the same issue at the same path; `ObjectSchema.create` refuses at module load (`invalid_format` at `fields.lock_state.options.1.value`); the documented transform still parses (`In Progress` → `in_progress`, and `v1.2` now declares `v1.2`).
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.select-shorthand-refusal.test.ts`: the save door's `code` + `status` + issue path, the explicit spelling's identical issues, and a control that the documented transform saves.
- `packages/metadata-core/src/objects/sys-metadata-audit-lock-state.test.ts`: `lock_state` is text, `maxLength: 255`, no options, read-only; exactly `no-overlay` and `no-delete` of `MetadataLockSchema` are values a select option cannot declare; the object parses.
- **Ablation** (one, on the behaviour the spec tests pin): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` re-inserted the strip into `field.zod.ts` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `9d7a024c0fbc` → `3162adcde7d2`); `field.test.ts` went 4 failed / 280 passed, the four new cases; restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Suites (on `88440a148`, before the ledger entry and merge; neither touches these packages' sources): `@objectstack/spec` 706 files / 21,463 tests passed; `@objectstack/metadata-core` 19 / 791; `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` 252 passed + 3 skipped files / 20,835 passed + 19 skipped tests; `@objectstack/platform-objects` 86 / 1,250. After the ledger entry: spec `src/migrations` + `field.test.ts` 6 files / 512 tests, and `typecheck` green for spec, metadata-core, metadata-protocol and platform-objects.
- Full-repo pin sweep: `git grep` for `nooverlay`, `nodelete`, `useragentbased` and `toSnakeCase` outside changelogs finds only the regenerated translation bundles, the earlier OAuth changeset and the CLI's own unrelated `toSnakeCase`. No fixture asserted the stripped values, so no pin flips.

## Acceptance notes

- The translated `lock_state` option labels (`禁止叠加`, …) never displayed: they were keyed `nooverlay` / `nodelete`, which no stored row holds. Dropping them changes nothing a user saw; the column now shows the stored spelling.
- `'v1.2'` used to declare `v12` and now declares `v1.2`, a valid identifier: a value change, not a refusal. The census found no in-tree shorthand with a dot.
- The explicit-object branch still lower-cases `value` (`{ value: 'Active' }` → `active`). That is documented and not a strip, so it is left alone here; recorded in the report as an open question.
